scientific_question: Is the rejected seven-trunk endpoint restriction caused primarily by tying c_fc, tying c_proj, or their nonlinear interaction?

causal_basis.reason: The complete exact-family splice is optimization-healthy but misses held-out output, JVP, and CE gates. Replacing one matrix family at a time in the same dense teacher isolates the two structural constraints without another fit.

variants.shared_c_fc_only: selected effective shared-family c_fc in layers 5-11; exact dense-teacher c_proj
variants.shared_c_proj_only: exact dense-teacher c_fc; selected effective shared-family c_proj in layers 5-11
variants.shared_both: selected effective shared-family c_fc and c_proj in layers 5-11

frozen_gates.per_side_function_pass: mean/worst output recovery at least 0.90/0.75 and mean/worst input-JVP recovery at least 0.80/0.50
frozen_gates.per_side_ce_pass: fixed validation CE gap no greater than +0.05
frozen_gates.c_fc_restriction: shared_c_fc_only fails either its function or CE gate while shared_c_proj_only passes both
frozen_gates.c_proj_restriction: shared_c_proj_only fails either its function or CE gate while shared_c_fc_only passes both
frozen_gates.interaction: report shared_both CE gap minus the sum of the two one-sided CE gaps; positive values indicate super-additive nonlinear damage

authorization.allowed: one zero-update, no-fit factorial on the exact selected state
not_allowed: changing the fit state or teacher
authorization.next: derive exactly one new compact function family from the localized failing side and its measured residual; preregister a representability oracle before training
